from pathlib import Path
import yaml, os, sqlite3, subprocess
from PIL import Image

root = Path('/home/user/.hermes')
me = root / 'profiles' / 'u732b-u732b'

print('=== 1. AVATAR ===')
av = me / 'assets' / 'avatar.png'
if av.exists():
    im = Image.open(av)
    print(f'exists=True size={im.size} mode={im.mode} format={im.format} bytes={av.stat().st_size}')
else:
    print('exists=False')

print('=== 2. SYMLINKS ===')
for rel in ['skills', 'memories/USER.md', 'memories/topics', 'memories/MEMORY.md', 'auth.json']:
    p = me / rel
    if p.is_symlink():
        tgt = p.readlink()
        print(f'{rel}: SYMLINK -> {tgt} (resolved_exists={p.exists()})')
    elif p.exists():
        print(f'{rel}: {"DIR" if p.is_dir() else "FILE"} (not symlink)')
    else:
        print(f'{rel}: MISSING')

print('=== 3. BACKUPS ===')
bdir = me / 'backups'
if bdir.exists():
    for sub in sorted(bdir.iterdir()):
        items = sorted(x.name for x in sub.iterdir()) if sub.is_dir() else [sub.name]
        print(f'  {sub.name}: {items}')

print('=== 4. CONFIG.YAML VALIDATION ===')
cfg = yaml.safe_load((me / 'config.yaml').read_text())
dcfg = yaml.safe_load((root / 'config.yaml').read_text())
print('model:', cfg.get('model'))
print('delegation:', cfg.get('delegation'))
print('reasoning_overrides:', cfg.get('reasoning_overrides'))
print('plugins:', cfg.get('plugins'))
print('skills:', cfg.get('skills'))
print('display:', cfg.get('display'))
print('gateway keys:', list((cfg.get('gateway') or {}).keys()))
print('default gateway keys:', list((dcfg.get('gateway') or {}).keys()))

db_path = (((cfg.get('plugins') or {}).get('hermes-memory-store') or {}).get('db_path'))
print('fact_store db_path:', db_path)
if db_path:
    dp = Path(os.path.expanduser(db_path))
    print('db exists:', dp.exists(), 'size:', dp.stat().st_size if dp.exists() else 0)
    if dp.exists():
        con = sqlite3.connect(f'file:{dp}?mode=ro', uri=True)
        cur = con.cursor()
        tables = [r[0] for r in cur.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'").fetchall()]
        print('db tables:', tables)
        if 'facts' in tables:
            print('facts count:', cur.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM facts').fetchone()[0])
        con.close()

print('=== 5. PROFILE.YAML VALIDATION ===')
py = yaml.safe_load((me / 'profile.yaml').read_text())
print('profile.yaml parsed:', py)

print('=== 6. GATEWAY / TUI_GATEWAY READBACK ===')
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'hermes-agent'))
try:
    from tui_gateway import methods_profiles as mp
    for fn_name in ['_build_profile_entry', '_read_profile_ui_meta', 'get_profile_avatar', '_find_asset']:
        if hasattr(mp, fn_name):
            print('has fn:', fn_name)
    if hasattr(mp, '_build_profile_entry'):
        print('_build_profile_entry:', mp._build_profile_entry('u732b-u732b'))
    elif hasattr(mp, 'list_profiles'):
        res = mp.list_profiles({})
        for p in (res.get('profiles') or res if isinstance(res, list) else []):
            if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get('name') == 'u732b-u732b':
                print('list_profiles entry:', p)
except Exception as e:
    print('tui_gateway check err:', repr(e))

print('=== 7. OTHER PROFILES UNTOUCHED CHECK ===')
out = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(root), 'status', '--short'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print('git status (first 40 lines):')
for line in out.stdout.splitlines()[:40]:
    print(' ', line)
